# evroc_service_account_credential (Resource)

Manages an evroc IAM service account credential. Supports RS256 JWT and HMAC-SigV4 credentials. Secrets are available only at creation and stored in Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "evroc_service_account" "application" {
  name    = "application"
  enabled = true
}

# Set this to the intended expiration time. Updating it replaces the credential.
variable "credential_expires_at" {
  type        = string
  description = "Credential expiration in RFC3339 format."
}

resource "evroc_service_account_credential" "hmac" {
  name                = "application-hmac"
  service_account_ref = evroc_service_account.application.fqid
  type                = "hmac-sigv4"
  expires_at          = var.credential_expires_at
}

# Assign the service account appropriate roles separately.
output "access_key_id" {
  value = evroc_service_account_credential.hmac.access_key_id
}

output "secret_access_key" {
  value     = evroc_service_account_credential.hmac.secret_access_key
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expires_at` (String) Expiration timestamp for the credential (RFC3339 format). Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `name` (String) Unique identifier for the credential. Immutable after creation. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `service_account_ref` (String) Fully qualified ID of the parent service account (e.g., /iam/projects/<project>/serviceAccounts/<name>). Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

### Optional

- `access_token_lifetime` (Number) Access token lifetime in seconds for RS256 JWT credentials. Cannot be set for hmac-sigv4. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the credential's purpose. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `project` (String) Project this credential belongs to. Defaults to the provider project. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `type` (String) Credential type: rs256-jwt (default) for OAuth or hmac-sigv4 for AWS Signature V4. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

### Read-Only

- `access_key_id` (String) Access key identifier for HMAC credentials.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the credential was created (RFC3339 format).
- `credential_id` (String) System-assigned unique identifier (UUID) of the credential.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `private_key_jwk` (String, Sensitive) Base64-encoded private key in JWK format. Only available at creation time.
- `revoked_at` (String) Revocation timestamp in RFC3339 format, or empty if not revoked.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) HMAC secret returned only at creation. Stored in Terraform state; protect state access.
